title: North Georgia Hiking and Adventuring
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
When are a full Service Hiking Company
- We transport you (both ways),
- We bring you to a local restaurant (not included in fees)
- We hike with you,
- We share our passion for the outdoors.

Saturday/Sunday: Operating to all desired locations: Preachers Rock, Red Top Mountain, Brasstown Bald, Fort Mountain
